why: Company PR Newswire release (2026-11-02): Q3 2026 results before the US open on 2026-11-18, call 8:00am ET; but ZIM is under a signed $35/share cash merger with Hapag-Lloyd, so the price is a deal spread, not an earnings multiple.
session_evidence: Company release: before U.S. markets open 2026-11-18, call 8:00am ET. https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/zim-to-release-third-quarter-2026-results-on-wednesday-november-18-2026-302926368.html
where_to_look: Deal status, not the quarter: regulatory approvals (Israeli golden share/state, EU/US antitrust) and expected close date - spot $29.64 vs $35 cash is a ~18% spread
Any competing proposal (management-led bid was rejected; reports of a richer offer) and the 'New ZIM' carve-out terms
Whether the release itself updates the closing timeline
already_in_the_wire: Container spot rates (SCFI/Drewry) are public weekly
trades_on: unknown; since the merger agreement it should trade on deal-closing risk rather than the quarter
